notes.title: Upstream is available NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jM8EMbWtU_o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What's Upstream?[/h2] 
[strike]Not much...[/strike] Play as a salmon journeying home in this challenging physics based platformer using only two buttons! Remember that on a voyage through innumerable obstacles and constant danger, it is your reaction to adversity that determines your success.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245890/Upstream/

🐟 Swim and jump your way to the Mountain Spring as a spawning salmon using only a left and right button.

🐟 Traverse environments based on different ecosystems from the Pacific Northwest.

🐟 Experience an educational and emotional story about the life cycle of a salmon with a bit of encouragement along the way if your progress isn’t always forward (or up).

🐟 Satisfy your completionist side by collecting salmonberries and salmon sense, and by finding all the secret areas.

🐟 Enjoy the game at your own pace with accessibility settings like: Key Rebinding, Hold-to-Swim, and Quicksave Mode!

🐟 A cute salmon.

Just keep swimming,
[b]Gllama Games[/b]

notes.title: Upstream Demo Hotfix: v.demo.0.8
notes.content:
We got a big list of changes here, many bug fixes and QoL changes for you all as we polish up the demo going into Next Fest this week.

Changes:
- The game timer now waits to start until the player enters a movement input or the fish is moved by an external force like a current.
- Subtitles will now be automatically disabled if narration is muted.
- Sound effects like splashes and collisions now scale based on the salmon's velocity.
- Button prompts in the tutorial now flash to draw more attention to them.
- If Salmon Sense is disabled, the Salmon Sense Collection Bar will not be visible.
- The keybind for quicksave will now only be visible in the Settings Menu when the QuickSave Gamemode is selected.

Fixes:
- Removed a Visual Artifact from the Main Menu Art
- Fixed a visual bug with water surfaces causing them to remain on screen if traveling at high speeds.
- Various UI tweaks.
- Fixed an error when transitioning between music areas.
- Fixed the lifespan of particle effects that appear when getting 100% of the collectibles in one run.

Thank you so much for playing the Upstream Demo, we are so grateful for your time. As always, if you encounter bugs of any kind, please submit a bug report using the link in the pause menu or on our website here: https://gllamagames.com/

Please be as detailed as you can so that we are able to properly address any issues that may arise.

Just keep swimming!
-Gllama Games

notes.title: Upstream Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
Thank you for following along with the development of Upstream! 

It’s been so fun to work on our first commercial project and see it slowly come to fruition. We’ve published a short playtest in the hopes of garnering some feedback on the gameplay. After playing it, please make sure to fill out the feedback form (linked in game on the intro screen and in the pause menu). We would really appreciate it!

Below are a few notes on the playtest.
[list]
[*]This is NOT a demo and thus the game is missing music, narration, among other things and is not finished. 
[*]Please fill out the feedback form linked in game during/after playing (there are some questions that require having the game open still). This is how we improve.
[*]Hit TAB to toggle a helpful overlay. Keep in mind the final game will NOT have this (at least not in the main game).
[*]Hit ESCAPE to toggle the pause menu.
[/list]
Thank you!
Gllama Games
